From 46891f23a74c401ad9613b875153819849d17925 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexander Turenko <alexander.turenko@tarantool.org>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2024 20:07:32 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] config: report all alerts of the same type

Before this patch `config:info().alerts` reports only last alert of a
certain type, while others are skipped. It is a regression from commit
fa97cc0c12e9 ("config: introduce droppable alerts").

The idea of the fix is to eliminate a key from all the alerts that are
not to be dropped later except on configuration reloading.

Fixes #9586

index 3ffd61e27..5d5468fbc 100644

         err = ('credentials.apply: box.schema.%s.%s(%q, %q, %q, %q) failed: %s')
               :format(role_or_user, grant_or_revoke, name, privs, obj_type,
                       obj_name, err)
-        config._aboard:set('credentials_grant_or_revoke_err',
-                           {type = 'error', message = err})
+        config._aboard:set({type = 'error', message = err})
     else
         local msg = "credentials.apply: %s %q hasn't been created yet, " ..
                     "'box.schema.%s.%s(%q, %q, %q, %q)' will be applied later"
         msg = msg:format(obj_type, obj_name, role_or_user, grant_or_revoke,
                          name, privs, obj_type, obj_name)
-        config._aboard:set('credentials_grant_or_revoke_warn',
-                           {type = 'warn', message = msg})
+        config._aboard:set({type = 'warn', message = msg})
     end
 end
 
@@ -700,8 +698,7 @@ local function set_password(user_name, password)
     if user_name == 'guest' then
         local message = 'credentials.apply: setting a password for ' ..
                         'the guest user is not allowed'
-        config._aboard:set('credentials_apply_password',
-                           {type = 'error', message = message})
+        config._aboard:set({type = 'error', message = message})
     end
 
     local auth_def = box.space._user.index.name:get({user_name})[5]

+local function aboard_set(self, alert, opts)

         log.warn(alert.message)
     end

+
+    local key

+    end

+    self._next_key = 1
